_doc: Developer Device Platform (DDP) catalog ids -> this repo's phones, for android/ddp/run_ddp.py (bench matrix --ddp <id>). An id is a pool, not a unit: each job of a session may land on another physical phone and firmware build, so every record names the unit it ran on (conditions.ddp / device.ddp: ro.build.fingerprint, ro.serialno). scheduleKey = the key of ops/dashboard-v1/schedule.json devices that exclude-on= rows name, and the source of the CPU mask (that device's cpu_mask: pixel8a f0, s26 none); null = no schedule device: no mask, and every row with an exclude-on= is skipped (ddp-device-key-unknown). display = the phone's name for the plan; product = ro.product.device. cpucapWaitSeconds = how long the wrapper waits before each run for every CPU policy's ceiling to come back to its hardware maximum (--cpucap_wait; absent = the attached-phone route's 300 s); a run that starts capped is flagged cpu-capped-at-start either way. Catalog ids read with `gcloud beta device-run devices list` (2026-10-15, LANE.md §0).

m1q-36._note: No cap wait (D14): in the 2026-10-15 slice (session-9002dfea, 8 SM-S942U1 units) all 24 runs started with policy0 at 3187/3629 MHz and policy6 at 3398/4742 MHz, and the 300 s wait timed out before every run without the ceiling lifting (2 h of device time); every record still carries cpu-capped-at-start (results/raw/2026-10-15-ddp-backend-dev/ROUND3.md).
